review_scope: Independent evidence/design-consistency review of the research blueprint; not production validation or exhaustive legal review
release_recommendation: Approved for publication as an evidence-backed research blueprint after verified corrections. Not deployment-ready.
checks_passed: 63 unique task records map to 20 role families; every task has a public-duty source, human owner and exception route.
26 A, 23 B and 14 C task counts reconcile; 79 public role advertisements reconcile to families without being represented as headcount.
57 unique contract rules link to six contracts; supplier process descriptions, contractual rules and documented ambiguities are distinguished.
Education totals reconcile to 2,764 and cross-site counts are limited to listing observations at snapshot times.
Public evidence is distinguished from proposed agents, workflows, data models and autonomy classifications.
Clinical practice/judgment, attestation, consequential employment decisions and financial exceptions have named human ownership.

Selected controls cover hiring-stage medical data, consent/background adverse-action sequencing, wage obligations independent of client billing approval, and location-specific deployment review without claiming a nationwide exhaustive checklist.
No unsupported total workforce, FTE savings, recovered production schema or achieved 100%-AI operation claims found.
